name.en-US: The Life and the Kingdom of Jesus in Christian Souls
name.pt-BR: A Vida e o Reino de Jesus nas almas cristãs

description.en-US: The 1946 English translation of John Eudes’s Life and Kingdom of Jesus in Christian Souls, complete, in seven parts.
description.pt-BR: A tradução inglesa de 1946 de A Vida e o Reino de Jesus nas almas cristãs, completa, em sete partes.

en-US.translator: a Trappist Father of the Abbey of Gethsemani

sources.edition: The Life and the Kingdom of Jesus in Christian Souls, translated by a Trappist Father of the Abbey of Gethsemani, New York, P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1946. Text layer of the Bibliothèque Saint Libère PDF (liberius.net), from the Eudist Fathers series, 1946–48.
sources.description: Converted by script: running heads and page numbers removed, paragraphs rejoined, hyphenation repaired. The OCR of the PDF text layer leaves some residual errors (for example 0 for O, rn for m); the translator’s introduction and notes are kept. The translation is not aligned chapter by chapter to the French edition, so it is a separate book.
sources.tierEvidence: Copyright 1946–48 P. J. Kenedy & Sons; no renewal in the Copyright Office records 1950–2001.
